svg.title: pi desktop — every screen, visual proposal, not implemented
svg.desc: Follow-up to desktop-thread-study.svg. New session, Tree, Changes, Context, Commands and Extensions are session views; All Sessions, Models, Resources and Settings are app views. Each uses only data pi exposes through RPC, session files, settings.json and pi list. All names, numbers and prices are sample data.

text.font-family: Commit Mono, Zed Plex Mono, SF Mono, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
Plantin MT Pro, Georgia, DejaVu Serif, serif

svg.text: Every part of pi, in one window.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Zed Plex Sans, Adwaita Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

svg.text: Session views are tabs or overlays on a session. App views sit at the bottom of the sidebar. Every screen uses data pi already exposes: RPC commands and events, session files, settings.json and pi list.
